diagnoses_and_repairs.emb2_m4_e5bundlecache_and_worker_io: Removed 30 incomplete H16S.bundle directories (missing weights/weights.bin) and 2 missing-milhash dirs in Core ML e5bundlecache on M4 Pro, restoring all 9 emb2_pk_s*_w8 buckets to rc=0 ANE=2288 GPU=0 CPU=0. Hardened scripts/benchmark_outcomes.py worker IPC with atomic --worker-out-file plus substring _WORKER_MARKER fallback.
diagnoses_and_repairs.kev_prefix_tree_interactive_admission: KevMlxBackend._resolve_prefix_tree defaulted admission_min_hits=2 even under profile='interactive', causing cold->warm 1-shot cache misses and unchunked-vs-chunked diff (0.051327). Defaulted admission_min_hits=1 for profile='interactive' (with optional prefix_admission_min_hits override) and passed profile='interactive' in scripts/_kev_benchmark.py; Base M5 rerun passed with 0.0 max_logit_diff and 3.039x speedup vs stock mlx-lm.
diagnoses_and_repairs.gemma4_mtp_b2_singleton_and_fallback: forward_verify_mtp_slot applied _singleton_verify_linear even at B>=2 (R=12), spilling Metal registers (0.185x on M4 free_b4), and declined MTP waves on Apple10/Apple9 fell back to unconstrained PromptLookup (0.560x on M5 free_b4). Gated singleton kernels strictly to B==1 and kept explicit-MTP declined waves on dense run_decode_rolling, achieving 10/10 exact AR/MTP parity on both Macs (M4 free_b4 1.130x; M5 free_b4 0.967x, json_b4 1.002x).
diagnoses_and_repairs.setup_all_qwen3_offline_snapshot: Updated scripts/setup_all.py _plan_qwen3 to verify cached Qwen3.5-4B-OptiQ-4bit snapshots via Qwen3Paths.is_complete_snapshot rather than bare snapshot_download without allow_patterns; --dry-run now reports [READY] (0.00 GB pending) on both Macs.
diagnoses_and_repairs.cat3_cat4_repeat_loop_probe: Sampled first 16 math_500 items on fast-gemma4 (1 flagged item had rep4=0.194 but finish_reason='stop' and exact_3x_periods=[], caused by >=8 algebraic 4-gram occurrences across 1,330 valid tokens) and all 150 bfcl_v3 items on fast-qwen3 (0 finish_reason='length' and 0 rep4>=0.15 at batch_size=30). Left shared compute_loop_breaker_penalties unchanged.
